div.div: 8 افتقأ الخَرْزَ is expl. in the K as meaning أَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الكُلْبَتَيْنِ كُلْبَةً أُخْرَى; [and in like manner in the O, except that the latte has الكُلْيَتَيْنِ and كُلْيَةً; and so have several copies of the K;] but this meaning is assigned by Lh to اقتفأ, which see for a fuller explanation. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
